assumptions_challenged: That program-specific MCB/WCB characterization and bank records are available or already generated.
That orthogonal intact-EV QC assays (with defined LLOQ, specificity, precision) have been developed or can be validated on the proposed schedule.
That a stability-indicating potency assay linked to an in vivo PD endpoint exists or can be established and validated within the proposed plan.
That  GMP-like batches have been produced and shown reproducible release/stability/potency across lots.
That formulation/device compatibility recovery has been demonstrated ex vivo and in vivo with appropriate controls.
That rodent intranasal signals reliably predict larger-species intact-EV CNS exposure absent validated, orthogonal intact-EV analytics and bridging data.
falsification_conditions: Provide Master Cell Bank (MCB) and Working Cell Bank (WCB) characterization and QC records (identity, adventitious agent testing, stability of bank).

Submit analytical validation reports for the orthogonal intact-EV QC panel (particle count, protein/lipid markers, separation from non-vesicular particles) including predefined acceptance criteria and demonstrated LLOQ, specificity, precision, accuracy.
Provide validation of a stability-indicating potency assay and data demonstrating linkage of that assay to a relevant in vivo PD endpoint.

Produce and supply three representative GMP-like batch manufacturing records with release specifications and stability datasets demonstrating lot-to-lot reproducibility of identity, purity, and potency.

Deliver formulation and device compatibility recovery studies (ex vivo and in vivo) with appropriate negative and positive controls showing intact-EV recovery and functional activity after processing/delivery.

Provide GLP large-animal intranasal biodistribution/tox studies that use the validated intact-EV assays (above) and include orthogonal controls demonstrating whether rodent signals translate to larger species.
strongest_objection: The proposed Stage-1 CMC/analytics gating package presumes program-specific production and validation data either exist or can be validated within the suggested timeline; the supplied evidence (MISEV2023 guidance only) does not demonstrate that these program-specific materials exist, nor that they will meet the stated fit-for-purpose criteria. Therefore the recommendation to proceed to cross-species bridging based on completion of that package is currently unsupported by any program data in the record.
